info.name: Orebit Admin — Chat
info.description: Admin chat routes (default http://localhost:3002). Sign in through the admin ceremony (POST /auth/login steps, then POST /2fa using the code from your configured second-factor provider): the response sets the orebit_admin_session cookie, and the CSRF token goes in csrfToken. Every POST sends x-csrf-token. Set roomId and id in the collection variables. Role assignment, chat-wide settings and a broadcast to every room need a SUPER ADMIN login.
